description: This file defines the StreamSubscriptionHandlerFactory class, which implements a factory for creating stream subscription handles within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages stream provider, stream ID, provider name, and subscription ID, and provides a method to create subscription handles for specific stream types.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating stream subscription handles, implementing IStreamSubscriptionHandleFactory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new StreamSubscriptionHandle for the specified stream type T.
